_comment: Cross-game narrative beats with no fire site. Each beat needs either a fireCrossGameBeat(beatId) call in apps/ TS code, OR a fire_cross_game_beat(beat_id) call in games/ GD code (CADES + DMC). The 18 entries here are grandfathered at the time the wiring guard was added (CONNECTION_AUDIT 2026-05-07 §6.3). The Godot-side bridge now exists (WebBridge.fire_cross_game_beat in both cades-fps and dead-mans-circuit autoloads), so wiring each beat at its canonical narrative moment is per-game writer work. PRs that add a fire site MUST also remove the corresponding entry here; the baseline can shrink but not grow.
